01 INDEX ANALYSIS

Symbolic indices survive a loop

Squin source
@squin.kernel
def bell_pairs(n: int):
    qs = squin.qalloc(8)
    for i in range(n):
        left = 2 * i
        right = left + 1
        squin.h(qs[left])
        squin.cx(qs[left], qs[right])
Index facts
left  = 2*i
right = 2*i + 1
right − left = 1

The indices differ in every iteration.

Caller requirement: 0 ≤ n ≤ 4
bell_pairs.print(analysis=analysis)

02 WIRE DIALECTS

State, gate and noise

Python-like wire form (schematic)
def noisy_bell_pair_wire(p):
    a0 = state.alloc()
    b0 = state.alloc()
    a1 = gate.h(a0)
    a2, b1 = gate.cx(a1, b0)
    a3 = noise.depolarize(p, a2)
    a4, m0 = state.measure(a3)
    b2, m1 = state.measure(b1)
    state.free(a4)
    state.free(b2)
    return m0, m1
stateCreates and consumes wire values.
gateReturns the next wire values.
noiseReturns the next noisy wire value.

04 CONVERSION

Calls, loops and branches

Squin source
@squin.kernel
def circuit(rounds: int, flip_second: bool):
    qs = squin.qalloc(2)
    for _ in range(rounds):
        entangle(qs[0], qs[1])
    if flip_second:
        squin.x(qs[1])
    return squin.broadcast.measure(qs)

wired = SquinToWire().emit(circuit)
restored = WireToSquin().emit(wired)
Python-like wire form (schematic)
def circuit_wire(rounds, flip_second):
    r = state.alloc_register(2)
    for _ in range(rounds):
        r, a = state.borrow(r, 0)
        r, b = state.borrow(r, 1)
        _, a, b = entangle_wire(a, b)
        r = state.release(r, 0, a)
        r = state.release(r, 1, b)
    if flip_second:
        r, b = state.borrow(r, 1)
        b = gate.x(b)
        r = state.release(r, 1, b)
    r, bits = state.register_measure(r)
    state.free_register(r)
    return bits

04 FUNCTION BOUNDARIES

The callee returns the next values

Python-like wire form (schematic)
def entangle_wire(a0: Wire, b0: Wire):
    a1 = gate.h(a0)
    a2, b1 = gate.cx(a1, b0)
    return None, a2, b1

05 JEFF EXCHANGE

A Bell circuit through a Jeff file

Python-like wire form (schematic)
def bell_pair_wire():
    a0 = state.alloc()
    b0 = state.alloc()
    a1 = gate.h(a0)
    a2, b1 = gate.cx(a1, b0)
    a3, m0 = state.measure(a2)
    b2, m1 = state.measure(b1)
    state.free(a3)
    state.free(b2)
    return m0, m1
Export and import
jeff = WireToJeff().emit(wired)
emit_jeff(jeff).write_out(path)

loaded = load_jeff(path)
imported = JeffToWire().emit(loaded)
restored = WireToSquin().emit(imported)

A fixed register becomes individual wires

a1 = gate.h(a0)
